name: [🔧FIXES] Tribe Survival 🏝️
desc:
Welcome to Tribe Survival! 🏝️

🎉Like the game and join the group for a free Party Hat (25% faster age)!🎉

🎂Gain age and survive longer to get stronger!
🌴Collect resources to build a base!
🤠Use your money to get rare and powerful hats!
🤝Join a tribe to survive with others!
⚔️Fight others to steal their wealth!

How long can you survive?

NOTE: Age and items are lost when leaving, but hats and money are saved.
⚠️Data is not saved in Private Servers!⚠️
